Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 5 , 5 ). Goal ( 1 , 4 ). Obstacles ( 0 , 1 ) ; ( 0 , 3 ) ; ( 2 , 1 ) ; ( 3 , 2 ) ; ( 5 , 3 ).
